name: Sandevistan
description: Adds the Sandevistan: a spinal speedware CBM that slows the world to a crawl.  While it runs your vision turns green, monsters nearly freeze and you leave a trail of rainbow afterimages.  Every move drains bionic power, and pushing it too hard overheats the unit: nosebleed, stun and a forced cooldown.  Both units can be picked at character creation.
